kind: supporting Rust multi-protocol chat transport library

runtime.execution: Tokio async clients/listeners/callbacks; caller supplies agent runtime; manager serial awaits.
runtime.service_boundary: Consumes external chat protocols or hosts listeners; owns transport connections/helper buffers, not models/shared computation fabric.

summary: Chat System supplies protocol-neutral messaging and listener callbacks plus group/stream helper primitives. Important exposed contracts have silent no-ops and IRC lifecycle/TLS limits.

inspection.scope: Selected source excerpts trace exposed entry/loop/request/action/result/state boundaries and relevant capability mechanisms; listed tests are read as source only.
inspection.limits: No acquired code executed, dependencies installed or live providers invoked. Claims concern this pinned snapshot; untraced catalog tools and dependency internals are not inferred.

actions.name: GenericMessenger::new / initialize / disconnect
actions.authority: caller supplies transport credentials/config; no model actor built in

actions.name: Messenger::send_message / send_message_with_options / receive_messages
actions.lifecycle: protocol await/poll; default options can be discarded; IRC IDs not receipt
actions.authority: caller or composed agent program; remote platform rules

actions.name: Messenger::set_typing / set_status / set_text_status / add_reaction / remove_reaction / get_profile_picture / set_profile_picture
actions.lifecycle: optional trait defaults silently succeed/None; not universal remote effect
actions.authority: caller account; unsupported operations not indicated by success

actions.name: Messenger::search_messages / edit_message / delete_message / pin_message / unpin_message / get_channel_members
actions.lifecycle: default empty/no-op; platform-specific support must be inspected separately
actions.authority: caller account; current API does not negotiate support

actions.name: MessengerManager::initialize_all / disconnect_all / receive_all / broadcast / get
actions.input: configured messenger list, recipient/content or name
actions.output: aggregated messages, per-backend results, optional handle
actions.lifecycle: serial awaits; receive errors swallowed to tracing; not concurrent fan-out
actions.authority: program owns backend list; backend credentials differ

actions.name: Server::add_listener / ChatServer::run / shutdown
actions.lifecycle: accept tasks concurrent; shutdown alive barrier excludes active connection children
actions.authority: caller owns listen address/callback authority; no model request engine

actions.name: GroupChatConfig::is_group_allowed / should_respond / session_key / strip_prefix
actions.output: boolean routing choice, stable key, stripped text
actions.lifecycle: pure helpers; caller must enforce and persist context

actions.name: StreamBuffer::push / finish / should_flush / flush
actions.lifecycle: monotonic local flush interval; no native provider/transport call
actions.authority: caller performs sends/edits and tracks remote ID

filesystem.detail: Not a coding filesystem agent; inspected transports and message helpers do not grant workspace tools.

processes.detail: No process lifecycle agent in traced IRC/manager/server paths; optional subprocess backends untraced.

code_actions.detail: Model-authored native tool program runtime outside messaging-library role.

standing_database.detail: General model-accessible standing query DB outside transport role; platform storage not inferred.

multi_model.detail: No model/provider selection or inference; supports chat transports, not model collaboration by itself.

compaction.detail: No model context compactor in inspected messaging/helper paths.

context_repair.detail: No model history restoration operation in traced transport/helpers.

rebuild_continuity.detail: No harness rebuild/context transfer protocol in transport library.

self_improvement.detail: No agent autoresearch/governed self-modification loop in transport library.

complaints.detail: No state-capturing agent complaint/bead/DB mechanism in inspected paths.

workflow_programming.detail: Rust async message callbacks and transport APIs compose custom workflows; no owned workflow scheduler/model loop.

live_collaboration.detail: IRC/platform clients are support transport, not multi-model room agent. Built-in IRC listener invokes per-connection callback and replies only there; no shared peer fan-out/member state.

concurrent_work.detail: Listener accepts multiple clients concurrently; manager broadcast/receive loops await serially. Active connection tasks outlive listener shutdown.

steering_interrupt.detail: Disconnect/listener shutdown supplied, but no model cancellation; shutdown does not drain connection callbacks.

turn_redefinition.detail: Caller chooses arbitrary async MessageHandler and pure group routing helpers; no predefined model turns to redefine.

original_audit.detail: Normalized transport messages with timestamps and optional edits; no full original/raw persistence in inspected IRC/core paths. Error swallowing and synthetic IDs limit study provenance.

audit_query.detail: SearchQuery optional trait returns empty by default; neither unsupported signal nor audit archive. Remote search implementation not traced.

hot_change.detail: Tagged config runtime selects backend at initialization, not watched reload; listeners added before run. No deferred affected-work boundary.

remote_services.detail: Unified clients consume external platforms; IRC TLS intent currently remains plain TCP, unlike optional TLS-server feature.

authority.detail: Transport credentials/network callback ownership; group policy helpers require caller enforcement. IRC listener accepts PRIVMSG before completed registration and has no traced auth/room authority.

evaluation.detail: Real localhost callback tests and Console-manager/pure group/stream assertions read only. Tests abort server and do not challenge shutdown child lifetime or TLS-client encryption.

time_order.detail: Stream uses Instant flush timing; normalized timestamps/IRC millisecond synthetic IDs do not establish durable seq/causal peer ordering or dedup.

evidence.claim: Multi-protocol Rust chat library claim, not model engine.
Runtime tagged config builds selected protocol backend, IRC TLS flag forwarded.
GenericMessenger builds/initializes backend then forwards operations; uninitialized calls error.
Unified lifecycle/send/receive and optional presence/reaction/profile/search/edit/delete/pin/membership operations; defaults silently no-op/empty.
Manager awaits backends serially for initialization/send/receive; receives warn-and-swallow individual errors, broadcast returns per-backend results.
Normalized message sender/channel/ID/time/thread/edit/media fields and SendOptions; not canonical causal event log.
IRC send_raw returns Ok when no connection; per-reader/writer async mutex and timeout read.
IRC TLS flag does not encrypt: stores Plain split TCP. Welcome wait timeout/EOF still proceeds joins and connected=true. Send ID derived recipient/content not server acknowledgment.
IRC receive polls until 100ms idle and parses wire fields; receive depends on caller pumping PING too.
Disconnect ignores QUIT failure then drops connection.
Per-client nick/USER registration and callback/reply processing; no shared peer routing/channel membership state; handler error silently omitted and PRIVMSG not gated on registered.
Listener spawns accept and per-connection tasks; shutdown only stops accept. Child connection tasks do not clone alive or receive shutdown.
Generic Rust async MessageHandler receives Message and returns optional reply.
Listeners added before run; no hot attach contract.
Server starts listeners and waits alive channel closure; shutdown signals listeners but does not await children/request quiescence.
Group eligibility, substring mention/prefix activation and isolation session-key helpers; exported support functions rather than automatic context owner.
StreamBuffer accumulates text and yields send/edit actions; chunked flush clears pending, edit-in-place full accumulated projection; caller must perform transport effects.
Pure streaming tests check action variants and chunk content/cleared length; no server edit acknowledgment.
Real localhost listener/client source test asserts callback exact received text; sleeps and aborts server task, not graceful shutdown oracle.
Two listener test sorts callback messages and asserts both arrived; no peer broadcast or child lifetime assertion.
In-memory Console backend tests check receive count and broadcast result count/Ok, not content delivery or remote APIs.
Pure mention/prefix/allow group predicate assertions, not model-context isolation persistence.
Representative authenticated external backend stores token, client, per-channel in-memory cursor and channel watch configuration.
Tokio Rust library; optional TLS server and platform dependencies distinct from plain IRC client flag.

tests.oracle: Real localhost socket tests exact text/both listener messages; fixed sleeps and abort teardown leave graceful child shutdown untested.
Console queue count and broadcast result count/Ok; weak delivery-content oracle and no remote backend.
Pure action variants/chunk text and cleared length; no actual remote edit effect.
Pure substring mention/prefix/allow-list decisions; no owned context store/isolation oracle.

strengths: Protocol-neutral callback and normalized message surface can support independently owned peer fabric.
Group routing keys and stream strategies are small separable composition primitives.
limits: IRC client TLS flag uses plain TCP; readiness can succeed after welcome timeout/EOF.
Built-in IRC listener is not a peer relay and shutdown omits active connection tasks.
Optional APIs silently succeed/empty when unsupported; manager swallows receive errors.
arconaut_questions: Should unsupported operations and transport receipt semantics be explicit sum types?
What room router, membership/authentication, durable causal audit and child quiescence would an owned fabric need?
